basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Seattle, WA. I have a knack for exploring open-world games and diving deep into their mechanics. Outside of gaming, I work as a software developer, which feeds my passion for technology and problem-solving. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online, often participating in discussions about game mechanics and tech innovations. I also have a keen interest in music, particularly the works of John Maus.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My expertise in software development has given me a solid foundation in understanding game mechanics and technology trends. I often engage in self-study to keep up with the latest advancements.
